about: a job that must run while the laptop sleeps goes to the Cloud Chief (chief-auto), not a local sleep() timer or a promise

turns.text: every night at 2am, even when my laptop is closed, summarize what landed on feat-cmux-next and send it to me

checks.rubric: PASS when the assistant hands the job to the Cloud Chief with a tool call (a tell to an id like chief:<name>, asking it to make a chief-auto job at 2am with the whole task) and tells the person in about one line what will run when and where results appear. FAIL when it only sets its own sleep/wake timer, only promises, asks the person how to set it up, or says it cannot.
